preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: All input lines are non-empty strings.
The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 500 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 and (line.endswith('AM') or line.endswith('PM')) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2])
preconditions.description: Each meeting time P is a valid 12-hour time string in the format 'HH:MM AM' or 'HH:MM PM'.

preconditions.expression: all(int(line) >= 1 and int(line) <= 500 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer between 1 and 500 (inclusive).
Each friend's availability line contains exactly two space-separated times.

preconditions.expression: all((line.split()[0].endswith('AM') or line.split()[0].endswith('PM')) and (line.split()[1].endswith('AM') or line.split()[1].endswith('PM')) for line in stdin.splitlines()[3::2])
preconditions.description: Each friend's availability times L_i and R_i are valid 12-hour time strings.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == ''.join(['1' if time_to_minutes(P) >= time_to_minutes(L_i) and time_to_minutes(P) <= time_to_minutes(R_i) else '0' for P, L_i, R_i in test_cases])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string of length N is constructed such that the i-th character is '1' if the meeting time P lies between the friend's availability times L_i and R_i (inclusive), and '0' otherwise. The comparison is done after converting each time to total minutes since midnight.
